title: UNI sensorium NDJSON envelope
description: The row shape every /var/lib/uni/** NDJSON spool wears (heartbeat.ndjson, prod-mcp.ndjson, programshot.json, colony_gate output, fleet_status.ndjson, any future OS spool). Single-writer per spool; atomic tmp+rename; readers must tolerate torn tails. Modelled on lib/sp/show/overlay_publisher.ex:22-105 and production/mcp/server.py:91-118 metadata().

source.description: Well-known source id. One of: heartbeat, programshot, colony_gate, prod_mcp, self_audit, fleet_status, uni_public_mcp, launcher_alert. Add new sources only after they land as supervised sole writers per production/docs/OS_SPOOL_POLICY.md.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision.

kind.description: row = one per tick / interval (heartbeat); event = discrete state change (approval, panic, alert); snapshot = full-state dump (self_audit).

payload.description: Source-specific payload. The source's supervised sole writer OWNS this shape and is the only place it may drift; consumers should tolerate unknown keys.

server.description: Which physical box wrote this row. Well-known: uni-lab | uni-lab-79740c | thinker | uni-tab-arm-1. Free-form for peers not yet in the mesh.

git_commit.description: The git HEAD SHA of the codebase that produced this row. Empty string only if the writer cannot read git (e.g. a raw shell probe on a stripped node).

evidence_class.description: Same taxonomy as gate_row.evidence_class. Rows never manufactured: any row a writer emits must be observation-of-fact (typically B or C).

audit_id.description: Optional cross-reference. For prod-mcp.ndjson rows this is the MCP call's audit_id; for heartbeat rows this is left empty.
